lesson.title: Central Tendency and Dispersion
intro: Measures of central tendency describe the center of a data set.
Common measures include the mean and median.
Measures of dispersion describe how spread out the data are.
Standard deviation and interquartile range are common measures of spread.

questions.prompt: The geometry test scores for Andrea and Joe are shown in the table below. Which statement about their test scores is correct?
choices: Both the mean and standard deviation of Andrea's test scores are higher than Joe's.
Both the mean and standard deviation of Joe's test scores are higher than Andrea's.
The mean of Andrea's test scores is higher than Joe's, but Joe's standard deviation is higher than Andrea's.
The mean of Joe's test scores is higher than Andrea's, but Andrea's standard deviation is higher than Joe's.
questions.explanation: Joe's scores have a higher average, but Andrea's scores vary more, giving her a larger standard deviation.

questions.prompt: The table below shows the highest temperatures recorded in August for several years in one town. The interquartile range of these data is
questions.explanation: Order the temperatures and determine Q1 and Q3. The interquartile range is Q3 − Q1 = 11.
